Bihar Police Admit Firing After Protesters Shot During Certificate Collection

Three protesters were shot and injured in Bihar's Siwan district after a clash with police. The incident occurred when protesters, who claimed they were there to collect certificates, were fired upon. Bihar Police admitted to firing shots, stating it was aerial firing. The protesters alleged they were shot by police. The exact circumstances leading to the firing remain disputed.
